title: Salon marketing ideas - hair & beauty salon advertising ideas

facts.fact: The Booksy page states that over 90% of consumers check online reviews before booking a new stylist (unsourced claim on the vendor's blog).
facts.quote: Over 90% of consumers check online reviews before booking a new stylist.

facts.fact: The Booksy page gives an example of a Meta ad targeting newly engaged women within a 10-mile radius of a salon.
facts.quote: you can place a "Bridal Styling" ad specifically in front of newly engaged women within a 10-mile radius of your salon.

facts.fact: The Booksy page says short-form 'Before and After' reveal videos capture attention in the first two seconds.
facts.quote: High-impact "Before and After" videos capture attention in the first two seconds.

facts.fact: The Booksy page recommends educational social media clips of about 15 seconds to explain at-home hair maintenance or styling tools.
facts.quote: Use 15-second clips to explain how to maintain a cool blonde at home or how to use a specific styling tool.

facts.fact: The Booksy salon marketing guide was published on 6 May 2024.
The page states that email returns an average of £38 for every £1 spent in the beauty industry.
facts.quote: Email returns an average of £38 for every £1 spent in the beauty industry.

facts.fact: The page states that SMS messages have open rates of around 98%.
facts.quote: With open rates sitting around 98%, text messaging is your best tool to fix a quiet week.

facts.fact: As an example referral offer, the page suggests giving a regular client £15 off their next service and giving their friend 20% off their first visit.
facts.quote: give your regular client £15 off their next service, while offering their friend 20% off their first visit.

facts.fact: As an example referral offer, the page suggests giving the new client 20% off their first visit.
facts.quote: while offering their friend 20% off their first visit.

facts.fact: The page suggests rewarding the top 10% of spenders with exclusive tiered perks.
facts.quote: Give your top 10% of spenders exclusive benefits

facts.fact: The page suggests triggering a 'We Miss You' incentive email if a regular client has not booked within 12 weeks.
facts.quote: if a regular client hasn't booked within 12 weeks, the system automatically sends a friendly "Come back and see us" incentive

facts.fact: The page suggests sending birthday rewards to land seven days before the client's birthday.
facts.quote: birthday rewards (like a complimentary luxury treatment) to land in your client's inbox seven days before their big day.

facts.fact: The page suggests sending automated Booksy SMS or email rebooking reminders 48 hours after a client declines to rebook.
facts.quote: Use automated SMS or email reminders through Booksy to catch them 48 hours later.

facts.fact: The page suggests inviting local micro-influencers who have a few thousand engaged followers.
facts.quote: Invite a local influencer with a few thousand engaged followers for a complimentary colour transformation

facts.fact: The page's 30-day action plan allocates days 1–7 to the digital audit, days 8–14 to the visual update, days 15–21 to the loyalty launch, and days 22–30 to automation setup.
